subject: Seat rebalancing + MFA & device-posture SOW request
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: enterprise-sales@okta.com
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Seat rebalancing + request for SOW covering MFA & device posture pilot

Hi team,

We’re coming up on the Acme Analytics renewal window and want to take a different approach this cycle: rather than a straight seat increase, we’d like to rebalance our allocation across business units and add a short device-posture pilot plus conditional-access hardening for our remote engineering org.

Targets:
- Reduce total billed seats by ~8% via inactive-user cleanup and seat pooling.
- Add a 3-month device-posture pilot scoped to 1,200 endpoints.
- Roll out adaptive MFA for high-risk admin flows.

Please send: 1) an updated quote that reflects seat rebalancing (seat-level pricing + any minimums), and 2) a draft SOW we can circulate (device-posture pilot + 3-week implementation, metrics and rollback criteria). Attach current seat utilization report for your reference — I’ve included it in the attachments.

Timeline: tentative renewal decision 2027-01-10; would like final commercial terms by 2026-12-15 to allow procurement review.

Thanks,
Olga
Product Security Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: current_seat_report.csv
From: Okta Sales <enterprise-sales@okta.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@acme-corp.com
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Seat rebalancing + request for SOW covering MFA & device posture pilot

Hi Olga,

Thanks for the context — appreciate the clear targets. We can do a rebalance and provide a pilot SOW. A few clarifying questions before we issue the updated quote/SOW:

1) When you say "seat pooling," do you want a pooled license model across orgs or reassignable seats managed via our admin API?
2) For the device-posture pilot, can you confirm the platform mix (Win/macOS/Linux/Mobile) and whether EDR telemetry will be shared?
3) Any required SLAs for the pilot support window (e.g., 24x7 vs business hours)?

Prelim pricing notes: we can offer a volume-based credit if you commit to a baseline for the next 12 months; exact discount depends on final effective seat count post-cleanup. I’ve attached a preliminary quote (quote_okta_enterprise_v3.pdf) for review.

If it helps, we can schedule 30 minutes this week for a scope call.

Regards,
Maya Singh
Senior Account Executive
Okta

Attachments: quote_okta_enterprise_v3.pdf
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Maya Singh <enterprise-sales@okta.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 15:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Seat rebalancing + request for SOW covering MFA & device posture pilot

Olga / Maya —

Quick notes from procurement/finance perspective before we lock timeline:
- We need the quote to show: current committed seats, proposed effective seats after cleanup, and the monthly billing cadence with any one-time implementation fees separated out.
- Ask Okta for an explicit credit term for deprovisioned seats (we want at least a 90-day credit window for seats flagged inactive).
- For the pilot SOW please include acceptance criteria: enrollment rate target, telemetry handoff, KPIs (mean time to remediation), and a rollback plan.

Attached is the latest seat export I pulled (current_seat_report.csv) — helps show which orgs have large pools of inactive seats. If Okta can provide an API-driven reallocation plan that minimizes manual admin work, that’s a plus.

Also pinging Jordan to coordinate the internal exec approval note — Jordan, we’ll likely need a 1-paragraph ask and a cost delta summary for the CET.

Thanks,
Marcus
Head of Procurement
Redwood Inference

Attachments: current_seat_report.csv
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: enterprise-sales@okta.com, procurement@acme-corp.com
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 16:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Seat rebalancing + request for SOW covering MFA & device posture pilot

Maya / team,

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the quote. I’m attaching a draft SOW for the device-posture pilot (draft_sow_okta_device_posture.docx) — this focuses on a 12-week engagement with the following checkpoints: week 2 baseline, week 6 mid-run review, week 10 hardening, week 12 acceptance.

Responses to your clarifying questions:
- Seat pooling: we prefer reassignable seats via API and an Okta admin job to automatically reclaim seats flagged as inactive for >90 days.
- Platform mix: ~70% Win, 25% macOS, 5% Linux; EDR telemetry will be available to Okta under an NDA.
- Support window: business-hours support with a 4-hour response target for pilot-critical incidents.

Next steps I propose:
1) Maya to send updated quote that separates one-time services vs recurring seat fees and includes the 90-day deprovision credit.
2) Okta to review and mark up the attached draft SOW.
3) Internal exec ask: Jordan will draft a short approval note (1 para + cost delta) by 2026-12-06.

Forwarding Maya’s quote below for context.

—Olga
Product Security Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: draft_sow_okta_device_posture.docx
